name: CreatePluginConfig

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the gateway
parameters.name: gateway_unique_id

parameters.help_en:
The application scope of the plug-in. Valid values:

*   0: global
*   1: route
*   2: domain name
parameters.help_zh:
插件应用范围。

- 全局：0
- 路由：1
- 域名：2
parameters.name: config_level

parameters.help_en: The plug-in configuration. The configuration content of the WebAssembly (Wasm) plug-in is in the YAML format. The configuration content of the Lua plug-in is Lua code
parameters.help_zh: 插件配置。Wasm 插件配置内容是 YAML 格式，Lua 插件配置内容是 Lua 代码
parameters.name: config

parameters.help_en: Indicates whether the plug-in is enabled
parameters.name: enable

parameters.help_en: The domain IDs or route IDs. They are distinguished based on ConfigLevel
parameters.help_zh: 域名ID/路由ID列表（根据ConfigLevel区分）
parameters.name: resource_id_list

parameters.help_en: The language in which you want to display the results. Valid values: zh and en. zh indicates Chinese, which is the default value. en indicates English
parameters.help_zh: 返回结果显示的语言。取值：zh（默认值）：中文，en：英文
parameters.name: accept_language
